chapter_seo_title: Ghost Spirit Sect Revealed – Demonic Superpower Steps Into Yue Nation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li steps into a political standoff at Yanling Fort. Foreign cultivators flood the teahouse—and the Ghost Spirit Sect, a demonic superpower, casts its shadow over the upcoming treasure assembly. A turning point looms.
og_title: Demonic Shadows Over Yanling Fort – The Ghost Spirit Sect Arrives
og_description: Han Li’s reconnaissance mission turns into a political thriller as the Ghost Spirit Sect, one of the Six Demonic Sects of Tianluo Nation, makes its presence felt at the Yan Clan’s treasure assembly.
twitter_title: A demonic sect just walked into the room—Ghost Spirit Gate is here
twitter_description: No treasure is worth this kind of attention. Han Li runs the numbers, and the numbers are terrifying.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the Six Demonic Sects of Tianluo Nation, specializing in ghost and demon arts, poison, and shadow techniques. The weakest among the six is still stronger than Yue’s strongest sect.
A coalition of evil-coded schools in Tianluo Nation, often scheming against one another but united when facing external threats.
The ruling immortal family of Yanling Fort; known to be wealthy and defensive, but currently swallowing its pride against the Ghost Spirit Sect.
A portion of a high-grade magic treasure's power sealed into a talisman; mid-grade ones are valuable but not world-shaking.
A cultivation wall that cannot be broken by medicine alone; requires karmic opportunity or an insight—a core Mortal Stream constraint.
The dominant orthodox power in the region, likely to check any expansionist move by the Six Demonic Sects.
A multi-volume geographical and anecdotal reference text kept by the Yue sects, covering the customs and cultivation world of nearby nations.
A high-grade spirit tea exclusive to the Yan Clan's teahouse; produces a glacier-like chill when drunk, leaving a long, fragrant aftertaste.
